Source Han Serif is published by Adobe under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
The font name table records the same terms. Name ID 0 is
"© 2017-2024 Adobe (http://www.adobe.com/), with Reserved Font Name 'Source'."
Name ID 7 is the Source trademark notice. Name ID 13 names SIL Open Font
License, Version 1.1. Name ID 14 is http://scripts.sil.org/OFL.

The full license text is OFL.txt in this directory. The license body matches
the SIL plaintext at https://openfontlicense.org/documents/OFL.txt. The
copyright lines at the top of OFL.txt are filled from name ID 0 and name ID 7.
OFL 1.1 allows this unmodified font to be bundled with software when that
notice and OFL.txt travel with the file. The git checkout keeps the font
beside OFL.txt and this file. The published crate ships OFL.txt and this file,
and leaves the font file out. `gzip -c` of the face is 14798216 bytes.
crates.io rejects an upload larger than 10485760 bytes.

HC is the Hong Kong and Macau region build used by pdfcraft-equity.
